compute_mse_predictions: compute mean squared error between predictions and reference values
compute_rmse_predictions: compute root mean squared error between predictions and reference values with squared=False
compute_multilist_mse: compute MSE on multi-dimensional predictions and references using multilist config
compute_raw_values_mse: compute MSE with multioutput='raw_values' to get per-output errors
compute_weighted_mse: compute MSE with sample_weight to apply weighted averaging over samples
